title: rust/lichen-schc/src/codec.rs: Panic on truncated UDP packets (40-47 bytes)
description:
The code `let coap = &packet[48..];` is executed outside the length guard at line 998. When a packet has 40 <= len < 48 bytes with next_header=17 (UDP), this slice operation panics because index 48 is out of bounds. The MQTT-SN port check block (lines 998-1006) is guarded by `if packet.len() >= 40 + 8`, but line 1008 is outside that guard and executes unconditionally for all UDP packets.

**Location:** line 1008
**Category:** correctness

**Fix suggestion:** Move the `let coap = &packet[48..];` line and subsequent OSCORE/CoAP compression logic inside a length check, or add `if packet.len() < 48 { /* fall through to uncompressed */ }` before line 1008.
close_reason: Fixed: Added length guard (packet.len() >= 48) before slicing at offset 48 in compress() for UDP packets. Truncated UDP packets (40-47 bytes) now fall through to uncompressed fallback instead of panicking. Added regression test truncated_udp_packet_no_panic.
